verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Angular is built around modular components and use Signals for fine-grained reactive state updates. Production users corroborate this: they report 'truly reusable encapsulated components' across apps of 20-60 components each, composed via @Input/@Output. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of component-local state management and encapsulation (the evidence is only headline-level marketing claims), and explicit docs on composition patterns for complex UIs.
